title: Finite-level amplification condition
statement:
Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be a cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g:Y'\to Y$ and $g':X'\to X$. Fix an adic coefficient datum $(A,I)$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], put $P_n=A/I^n$ for $n\geq1$, and fix a nonnegative integer $c$. Use the scheme and coefficient conventions of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-direct-image-finiteness] wherever $\mathrm{FIN}$ is used. The finite-coefficient sheaves and the strictly full bounded constructible categories $D^b_c(T_{\Proet},P_n)$ are those of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]; the ambient derived operations are those of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], with the inverse-image identifications of the coefficient sheaves at each level.

Define $\mathrm{AMP}(\square;c)$ to mean that, for every integer $n\geq1$, both of the following conditions hold:

1. $\mathrm{FIN}(f,P_n;c)$ and $\mathrm{FIN}(f',P_n;c)$ hold in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-direct-image-finiteness], with this same fixed bound $c$ for both morphisms and all levels. Thus all $R^qf_*F$ and $R^qf'_*F'$ are constructible for constructible $P_n$-module sheaves $F$ on $X_{\Proet}$ and $F'$ on $X'_{\Proet}$, and they vanish for $q>c$.
2. The finite-level derived pullbacks restrict to exact triangulated functors
$$
\begin{aligned}
 Lg_n^* &:D^b_c(Y_{\Proet},P_n)\longrightarrow D^b_c(Y'_{\Proet},P_n),\\
 Lg_n'^* &:D^b_c(X_{\Proet},P_n)\longrightarrow D^b_c(X'_{\Proet},P_n).
\end{aligned}
$$
Here exact triangulated means additive, equipped with the shift isomorphism, and preserving distinguished triangles [def-weil-triangulated-category], for the structures induced from the ambient derived categories. For every pair of integers $a\leq b$, each of these functors carries an object with cohomology in $[a,b]$ to an object with cohomology in the same interval.

For $T=X,Y,X',Y'$, the notation $D^b_c(T_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]}$ denotes the full class of objects $K$ of $D^b_c(T_{\Proet},P_n)$ such that $\mathcal H^i(K)=0$ for every integer $i<a$ or $i>b$. This is a predicate on the square and the fixed bound; its definition does not assert that it holds for an arbitrary square.

blueprint_update.statement:
For a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] $\square$ with
$\Lambda$-coefficient data as in the adic coefficient datum, write
$\mathrm{AMP}(\square;c)$ if, for every $n\geq1$, with $P_n=A/I^n$ and
$\Lambda=P_n$:

1. the finite-level direct images satisfy the finiteness conditions
   [def-weil-pbc-constructible-direct-image-finiteness]
   $\mathrm{FIN}(f,P_n;c)$ and $\mathrm{FIN}(f',P_n;c)$;
2. the finite-level pullbacks $Lg_n^*,Lg_n'^*$ restrict to exact
   triangulated functors
   $$
    \begin{aligned}
     Lg_n^* &:D^b_c(Y_{\Proet},P_n)\longrightarrow
              D^b_c(Y'_{\Proet},P_n),\\
     Lg_n'^* &:D^b_c(X_{\Proet},P_n)\longrightarrow
               D^b_c(X'_{\Proet},P_n)
    \end{aligned}
   $$
   which carry objects with cohomology in $[a,b]$ into objects with
   cohomology in $[a,b]$.

Here $D^b_c(Z_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]}$ denotes the full class of objects of
$D^b_c(Z_{\Proet},P_n)$ whose cohomology vanishes outside $[a,b]$.

Conditions (1) and (2) imply the amplitude containments for
$Rf_*,Rf'_*,Lg_n^*,Lg_n'^*$.
